source.title: PS, DIG emphasize need for accountability in the fight against gender-based violence | State Department For Gender and Affirmative Action

notes: The Kenya Police Service lists its police hotlines as 999 / 112 / 911. Source: https://www.kenyapolice.go.ke/, retrieved 2026-09-26.

1195 is a toll-free gender-based violence helpline domiciled in the State Department for Gender; GBV can also be reported at the nearest police station. Source: https://www.gender.go.ke/resources/news/ps-dig-emphasize-need-accountability-fight-against-gender-based-violence, retrieved 2026-09-26.
